placements.why: The organization establishes release gate verification and ownership governance to control deployments across environments.
placements.title: Release Verification and Deployment Governance
placements.frame: How do deployment gates and artifact verification policies safeguard release environments?

placements.title: Signed Manifests Enforce Release Integrity
placements.frame: How does requiring cryptographically signed release manifests prevent unverified artifacts from reaching deployment environments?
placements.why: Establishes a mandatory gate requiring signed release manifests for all Meridian deploys to staging and production following an incident with unsigned artifacts.
